about: Fred RS on deep intraday charts (2026-11-28): SP:SPX's extended-hours grid starts at the chart's first bar (plus the one row before it), so a deep index store never passes the run's 32,768-bar HISTORY ceiling, and a missing chart bar stays the hole it was.

mutants.mutant: the grid is laid over the store's whole depth again (no `from`)
the row before the chart's first bar is dropped (a hole at the chart's start reads as a depth gap)
